x: Going back another decade I notice the name of Stan Scarsbrook amongst the new members. He must be the chap who in 1934 won the AAA 2m Steeplechase, followed by a win in the Empire (now Commonwealth) Games Steeplechase.

We were sorry to hear, last September, of the death of Stan Scarsbrook, just one month short of his 90th birthday. Stan joined Belgrave Harriers in 1993 but it was more a case of ‘rejoining’ as he had been a member of Surrey Athletic Club back in the 1930s.
Sadly, four members of the Club died during the last twelve months: Gwen Cousins, Jimmy Green, Ron Severn and Stan Scarsbrook, as also did Rose Morrell.
